sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT XIV OF 1995
ACT XIV OF 1995
SINDH SPEAKER'S AND DEPUTY SPEAKER'S (SALARIES, ALLOWANCES AND
PRIVILEGES) (SECOND AMENDMENT) ACT, 1995
An Act to amend the Sindh
Speaker's and Deputy Speaker's (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary, Part IV 26th November, 1995]
No.PAS/Legis-B-20/95, dated
26-11-1995.---The Sindh Speaker's and Deputy Speaker's (Salaries, Allowances
and Privileges) (Second Amendment) Act, 1995 having been passed by the
Provincial Assembly of Sindh tin the 28th September, 1995 and assented to by
the Governor of Sindh on 7th November, 1995 is hereby published as an Act of
the Legislature of Sindh.
1. Short title and commencement.--(1) This Act may be called the
Sindh Speaker's and Deputy Speaker's (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges)
(Second Amendment) Act, 1995.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of section l3 of Sindh Act, VII of 1975

ACT XIV OF 1995
ACT XIV OF 1995
SINDH SPEAKER'S AND DEPUTY SPEAKER'S (SALARIES, ALLOWANCES AND
PRIVILEGES) (SECOND AMENDMENT) ACT, 1995
An Act to amend the Sindh
Speaker's and Deputy Speaker's (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary, Part IV 26th November, 1995]
No.PAS/Legis-B-20/95, dated
26-11-1995.---The Sindh Speaker's and Deputy Speaker's (Salaries, Allowances
and Privileges) (Second Amendment) Act, 1995 having been passed by the
Provincial Assembly of Sindh tin the 28th September, 1995 and assented to by
the Governor of Sindh on 7th November, 1995 is hereby published as an Act of
the Legislature of Sindh.
2. Amendment of section l3 of Sindh Act, VII of 1975.--In the
Speaker's and Deputy Speaker's (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975,
in section 13, in subsection (l), for the words "for an aggregate period
not exceeding three months during the whole term of his office", the words
"for a period not exceeding three months in a year" shall be substituted.
